effect_description_eng: [On Play] Reveal the top 3 cards of your deck. Add 1 card with [Vegetation], [Plant] or [Fairy] in any of its traits and 1 [Yoshino Fujieda] among them to your hand. Place the rest at the bottom of your deck in any order.
inherited_effect_description_eng: [Your Turn] [Once Per Turn] When this Digimon would digivolve, if you have a green Tamer in play, reduce the digivolution cost by 1.
